question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Have you ever broken up then gotten back together with a significant other?
Do you think Colt and Sam should have gotten back together?
options: No, they have too many issues!
It could have gone either way.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Can you hear me if I talk like this?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Can you hear me if I talk like this?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw, babe, you don't have to yell.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you sure about `us?` We're getting back together, and it's happening so fast...
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you sure about [color=#3b78e2][i]us?[/i][/color] We're getting back together, and it's happening so fast...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're fine. I promise. We can work out the details later...
Colt kisses Sam.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're really worried about this?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't look like that. Let's get away from here, and we'll talk.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay...
Colt and Sam leave the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Anyway, I should go.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I heard the nerds are going to put a movie on upstairs. I'd better find Ben so we don't miss the previews... Or something.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're staying longer? I thought you turned into a pumpkin at midnight.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I enjoy a party as much as the next girl.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: When I look at you, I don't see the partying type, Princess.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh? What do you see?
At that moment, Hector goes to the center of the room and calls for attention.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, Centerscorers! The hot tub is now warmed up and open for business.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So if you're looking for a way to heat up your night...
Hector's cell phone rings!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... I've got to take this. Enjoy the hot tub, people!
Hector ducks out.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Tell me your problem...
The party-goers head outside.

nodes.speaker: Fryan
nodes.text: Hey, Ryan, get your lug head over here. You know what hangs out in hot tubs? `Hotties.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, Ryan, get your lug head over here. You know what hangs out in hot tubs? [color=#e23b3b][i]Hotties.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Let's go, cuz.
Across the room, Colt and Sam exchange glances.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A hot tub? Are you thinking what I'm thinking, babe?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thought you'd never ask.
Sam, Colt, and the others change and head out to the hot tub.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I hope you two are happy. I'm glad you're able to forgive and forget...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's wrong with you? You aren't choking, are you?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Is` she okay?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Is[/i][/color] she okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course I am. I'm just... Making a statement.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Silently.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Silently.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A statement about what?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I think I get it. It's a girl thing, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw, man...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I shouldn't be mean. She did apologize, after all.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, Denni. We talked about it, and it seems like everything's going to work out.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Awesome things happen to those who are awesome.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're so full of it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But you like it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, I can't believe I'm willing to put up with you again.
Colt kisses Sam on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think we'll be very happy.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's so...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Great!` That's so great.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Great![/i][/color] That's so great.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's about us. I didn't know what to say to Howard and...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You totally choked?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I did not! I just had no idea what to say to that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're together, Sam. For good. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Colt, I'm a little worried that we're moving too fast... We're `getting back together...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, Colt, I'm a little worried that we're moving too fast... We're [color=#3b78e2][i]getting back together...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're `letting Zach wear leather?`
nodes.text_bbcode: We're [color=#e23b3b][i]letting Zach wear leather?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not sure I want to know more about that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! I want to talk about us as a couple. I'm not sure we should've taken this chance.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We should so have `bacon at a dance!`
nodes.text_bbcode: We should so have [color=#e23b3b][i]bacon at a dance![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This whole mess spells trouble.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Your sole dress has stubble?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Now, that just doesn't make sense.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Arg... Can we go somewhere else to talk?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You want to `walk?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You want to [color=#e23b3b][i]walk?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Close enough.
Sam drags Colt off the dance floor.
At the snack table, Colt gets two cups of punch for them.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You want to talk? So talk.
They shimmy on to the dance floor where the music is bumping!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is great... But I did want to talk to Colt about us...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Do you think we made the right move?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Do you think we're doing the right thing? You know, about 'us'?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can't hear you! Music's too loud!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: At least for tonight.
Colt winks at Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Huh.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't tell if he's being sarcastic or not...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh... Good for you guys. That's cool.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks, Vanilla. That's how I roll.
Colt looks down at Sam.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Want to dance, babe? They're playing our song...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They are not!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Every song's our song if we're together.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hee hee. I guess I can't say 'no' to that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Then what were we making out in the hallway for?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not like we were exactly `talking.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not like we were exactly [color=#3b78e2][i]talking.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As you can see, we're still working it out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, Colt. Don't be like that.
Sam takes Colt's hand.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know... They're playing our song...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...They are not.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, it worked for you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can't argue with that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Then what were we making out in the hallway for?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not like we were exactly `talking.`

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As you can see, we're still working it out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, Colt. Don't be like that.
Sam takes Colt's hand.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know... They're playing our song...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...They are not.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, it worked for you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can't argue with that...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But are you sure about this? What about everything you've done?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You quit cheerleading, you joined the swim team...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought you were finally moving on. And now...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now I'm just afraid you're going to get hurt again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know this has happened before. Colt went on a date with Taylor, you followed them, you guys made up and decided to get back together..

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And we all know how that ended.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's not reliable, Sam. I don't trust him, and I don't think you should either.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll be fine. I know what I'm doing. It'll work this time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you say so...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Relax, $ZOE. I don't need you to watch over me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And what about Denni? What Colt did was inexcusable.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He feels really bad about all that. I know it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why else would he be here? He `hates` these dances, so the only reason he came was because of me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Why else would he be here? He [color=#3b78e2][i]hates[/i][/color] these dances, so the only reason he came was because of me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I can't help but feel like that means something.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, I'm willing to give us a chance again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay...
Howard opens the door from the dance floor to the school hallway.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You two ready to go? The limo's almost on its way out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Never been more ready in my life.
At Hector's house, Amanda answers the door and pokes her head out.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wow, it's so nighttime outside!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess you could say that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, sure, Amanda... Are you going to let us in now?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh yeah! Hello and welcome!
Amanda steps aside to let everyone in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, everything looks great! Is that... Is that an ice unicorn in the center of that table?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector froze one for me! Isn't it sparkly?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Don't ride it though. It's a slippery one...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We'll try not to.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Amanda. Where's Hector?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector's on the phone. Something about helping people with their problems?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I don't know why he keeps touching it, if it's so hot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, you mean the Prom `hotline?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, you mean the Prom [color=#3b78e2][i]hotline?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah that! Anyway, enjoy yourselves! Don't put your tongue on the ice tray if you can help it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Will do, Amanda.
They walk into the downstairs den, where the party is happening!
At the far end, Amanda rushes to and fro, while Hector follows her hurriedly, a cell phone pressed to his ear.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, don't you think you should take a break?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I promise, Manda-Panda. This is the `last` call!
nodes.text_bbcode: I promise, Manda-Panda. This is the [color=#e23b3b][i]last[/i][/color] call!

nodes.text: Near the music speakers, the strange trio of Astrid, Denni, and Prissy talk.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You know, your dress isn't awful for a commoner.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I think it is a marvelous frock! It makes you look like a tiny cupcake! I could eat you!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Please don't.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course Denni would be here too... I'm surprised Colt hasn't found her by now.
Suddenly, reassuring arms wrap around Sam!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Sammy...
Colt plants a kiss on Sam's cheek.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hello, you.
Sam looks over and sees Howard staring.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Er... So I guess you two are back together now?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Out on the dance floor, we were arguing and talking about the past, and then our song came on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It seemed like a sign, and in that moment, $ZOE, he kissed me and...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Everything felt right again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe it's not the best reason, but it's my reason.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I can understand that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So? He's apologized a million times before.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you didn't give in then.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Give in? I didn't just give in. I thought really hard about what I was doing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Do you think I would just rush into something if I didn't think it was a good idea?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I'm not! And he seemed genuinely apologetic this time.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, maybe it's not the perfectly right decision, but we can't all be perfect like `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, maybe it's not the perfectly right decision, but we can't all be perfect like [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Sam. I was just surprised.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You were heartbroken for a long time, and I don't want to see you like that again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But you love Colt, and I guess I can understand how you feel...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I missed you too.
Suddenly, inside the gym, the music changes to a slow, sweet song.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: They're playing our song.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, they are...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You know what that means.
Colt puts an arm on Sam's waist...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't think this is a good idea...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If it were, I wouldn't be doing it.
And Sam buries her head in Colt's chest. They sway softly to the music.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I almost forgot... But this feels really nice.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Sammy...
Sam looks up, and Colt kisses her!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Mmmmmm...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mmmm...
Colt pulls away.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you sure about this?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Never been surer.
Colt leans down to kiss Sam again...
Back in the present...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And then he...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Stop! I don't need to hear anymore. The visual is bad enough without you telling me the details.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Does that explain everything?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not quite... I'm still confused. So he said some nice things, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Why were you making out with Colt?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Why were you making out with Colt?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You said you would never go back to him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, something happened, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw, Sammy...
Colt releases her.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I want to be with you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know what else I have to do to convince you of that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Would it help if I said that I missed you?
Sam hugs Colt tightly before pulling away.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm glad you didn't slap me in the face.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You probably deserved it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I missed you.
As of the last episode, $ZOE, Howard, and company have arrived at the dance, and Prom is in full swing!
In one lonely corner of the room, Brendan leaves another message on Dinah's phone...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, Dinah, how are you? This is an answering machine, so you won't reply to that, but wherever you are, I hope the answer is 'I'm okay!'

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I know it's a long drive from your school to mine, but I wanted you to know I'm still waiting for you so our awesome date can begin.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I miss you. Okay, well, bye.
Meanwhile, $ZOE and Howard are on the dance floor...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you, $ZOE... And no matter what Astrid does, it won't make a difference to me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Prom is perfect because of you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you, Howard.
They enjoy the rest of the evening until...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, Prom's been fun, everyone, but it's time for the afterparty at my house!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ha ha, okay. $ZOE, ready to go?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I need to go freshen up real quick, okay? I'll be right back.
$ZOE steps out into the dark hallway, en route to the girl's bathroom. She takes a few steps forward... And bumps into a couple making out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh! Excuse me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Colt?!
The couple freezes and stares at her...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Sam?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sam?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I... You two are... What is going on?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Colt, what did you do to her?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, I didn't do anything! Ask Sammy if you don't believe me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll handle this. You go on ahead, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll see you at Hector's afterparty?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. See you then.
Colt kisses her on the cheek, then leaves.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay. Let me explain...
A couple hours earlier...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE? Where are...
Sam freezes. There, on the far side of the room, is Colt leaning over Denni!
Denni, dressed in a long gown that flatters her small figure, laughs at something Colt says as he shrugs playfully.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...You jerk. You unbelievable jerk.
Sam turns and storms out of the gym. On the other side of the room...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't tell me you're actually excited to be here, shortstop.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Of course I am. It's my first Prom!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's so freshman of you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, it's stupidly hot in here. I'm going to stand in the hall for a second. Nice seeing you.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sure.
Colt walks into the hall... And hears quiet sobbing somewhere in the darkness.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go away, you jerk.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sam, is that you? Why are you crying? Hey, what's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sniffle, sniffle... I'll tell you what's wrong.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just... Just what do you think you're doing here?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's a dance. It's not like I need an invitation.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you don't go to dances. Especially not Prom. You told me you'd rather be caught dead!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm here now, aren't I?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You said that Prom was for suckers!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It `is` for suckers. But maybe I came for a specific reason...
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] for suckers. But maybe I came for a specific reason...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Your reason looks a lot like `Denni.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Your reason looks a lot like [color=#3b78e2][i]Denni.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, that's uncalled for. And what do you care anyway? We're not together anymore.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course I care! I... I just can't believe you'd come just for `her!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course I care! I... I just can't believe you'd come just for [color=#3b78e2][i]her![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I didn't come for her! I came for `you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't come for her! I came for [color=#e23b3b][i]you![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why else would I be here? I couldn't stand the idea that you'd be with someone else.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And it just made me realize that all I want is to be with you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh yeah? And what about Denni?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni is just a friend. I swear to you, I don't have any feelings for her. I don't care about her at all.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I care about you. And I hate how things ended. The mess with that stupid kiss, the entire thing. I don't know how I can change anything, but...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sammy, I love you.
Colt puts his arms around Sam and draws her close.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, I just need to break this down.
Sam makes a box with her forefingers and thumbs.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Television show!
Sam raises two fingers.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Two words!
Sam now raises only one finger.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: First word!
Sam cups a hand to her ear.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sounds like...
Sam runs around the small space in front of the others.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Run? Sprint? Mint? Stint?
Sam shakes her head and mimics running across a finishing line.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sounds like race!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A television show that's two words, and the first word rhymes with 'race'?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, that's... `Space 'Splosions!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, that's... [color=#e23b3b][i]Space 'Splosions![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes! `Yes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes! [color=#3b78e2][i]Yes![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam sits down triumphantly and kisses Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: See? What'd I tell you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How'd you guess that, Colt?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's because I know Sam so well...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It also helps that I know Erik loves Space 'Splosions.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Good job, Sam! Next up is Hannah...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Me? What about this guy?
He turns to Fryan and points at him.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you think you're doing?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, what are `you` doing?
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt, what are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing?

nodes.speaker: Fryan
nodes.text: Well, I know what I'm doing...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Look, I don't need you to be rescuing me all the time, Colt!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can handle everything myself!
Denni runs off as fast as she can.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know what her problem is.

Sam runs up and gets in between both boys.

Howard and $ZOE step forward.

Colt goes through the motions again.

Colt starts making digging motions.

nodes.text: What is that? A mole? A shrew?

nodes.text: Wait! I know! It's a gopher!

nodes.text: Colt's phrase is the 'Great Gopher'!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That sounds utterly ridic...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And Denni successfully guesses the answer! Isn't this exciting?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `That` was the clue?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] was the clue?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's the title of a kid's book that I used to read in grade school.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. That was the only book my dad read to me as a kid. I loved that stupid gopher. My favorite part was when he met the squirrels...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...And helped them collect the nuts for winter?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! Anyway, tiny hipster, that was a good guess.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I wouldn't have gotten it if Sam hadn't said 'shrew'. It was all thanks to her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, great. All thanks to me.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And with Denni's guess... That makes her team the winner!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Good game, you guys.
Everyone stands up and heads towards the snack table.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Geez, that last clue was pretty crazy, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, if you say so. But we got it, right? Nice guess, Denni.

nodes.speaker: Denni

At the snack table...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My favorite part was when Howard had to act out the word 'slobberknocker'! He acted like a dog!

nodes.text: In my defense, dogs slobber.

nodes.text: And knock on doors?

nodes.text: I can't believe you roped me into doing this.
At that moment, Zach approaches their group.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey. Good win, Danny.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, uh, it's Denni.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah, what I said. You know, I hate losing. On the football field, I'm an animal! I always win.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: But I don't mind losing to someone as cute as you.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh, thanks... I guess.
At that moment, Fryan and Ryan elbow past Zach.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hi, freshman girl... I'm Ryan. And I must say you look hot.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Save it, Ryan. I know exactly who you are.

nodes.speaker: Fryan
nodes.text: But I don't think we've met... Hi, I'm Fryan.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Is that really your name?

nodes.speaker: Fryan
nodes.text: It's because I'm cool like a fryin' pan.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ha. That doesn't even make sense.

nodes.speaker: Fryan
nodes.text: I can't fool you. I always knew that shorter girls were cuter.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh really? And why's that?

nodes.speaker: Fryan
nodes.text: They're uh... More petite and weigh less.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How... Disarming.

nodes.speaker: Fryan
nodes.text: Hey, speaking of losing our arms...
Fryan puts his hand on Denni's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Fryan
nodes.text: What do you say we go outside and lose some...
Colt rushes up and shoves him!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, lay off there, handsy.

nodes.speaker: Fryan
nodes.text: What's it to you, buddy?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Fight! Fight!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, your waving arm is its body, and the head is set to strike!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did I get it right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wrong animal... But the fact you thought it was a snake was pretty funny.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, Colt, no talking! You have ten seconds left!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Right, right...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, your waving arm is its wings in flight... And your hand is a duck bill!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Like I'd really be imitating something that looks like a chicken!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Where the heck would you get `that` idea?
nodes.text_bbcode: Where the heck would you get [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] idea?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry you look so duck-like!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, Colt, no talking!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If you keep acting, maybe Sam will get it on the next go around? You only have ten seconds left!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Right, right...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Some kind of rock?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You've got to have a better guess than that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, maybe if you gestured more clearly, I'd have something to say!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! I didn't see you winning any awards when you were up here.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, Colt, no talking!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If you keep acting, maybe Sam will get it on the next go around? You only have ten seconds left!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Right, right...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, I know! It's not where he's going. It's what he's holding! It's a grate!
Colt points at Denni!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? I don't get it. 'Grate'? What's a phrase that starts with 'grate'?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It doesn't start with that word. It's a 'sounds like'... So maybe the first word is 'great'!
Colt holds up two fingers.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Second word.
Colt puts his right elbow up, cocks his right hand, and wags it back and forth. He waves his left arm.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't think I understand what it is, but... It looks like some sort of animal...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's breaking into something!
Colt points at Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I knew I was close...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what is he breaking into? A vault? A cellar?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A bank?
Colt shakes his head emphatically and does the motion again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's, uh, digging?
Colt frowns at Sam and shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe it's where he's going? Down?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Town?
Colt shakes his head emphatically and does the motion again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If I just act like a spaceship, one of them will have to guess the right one!
Sam holds her arms out and starts zooming around the room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Flying? Like a bird?
Sam continues to zoom around.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A plane? A train? Some kind of vehicle?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ooh! I know, it's she's a duck!
Sam stops and glares at him.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What?
For the next full minute, Sam continues to act like a spaceship until...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And time's up!
Sam marches up to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's Space 'Splosions!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And you were some sort of alien duck?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I was a spaceship! Do you not know me at all?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What does that have to do with anything?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You should be able to read me by now.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You know I hate to read anything.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not what I meant...

nodes.text: Er, guys, can we get the next person up here? Charades waits for no man.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Good try all around! Next up is Hannah...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes, I... I'm sorry. Tonight's been really emotional.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... It's okay.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's go inside, Colt. I've had enough of the hot tub.
In the den, a bunch of students have gathered around.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: So you guys are going to play a game?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah, we're going to need more people though. Hey, $ZOE, Howard, wanna join?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A game? Sounds like fun!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Sam, you and Colt should join us too! The more, the merrier, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You sure it's okay that I be seen with you cheerleaders? What would Taylor think?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Taylor's not going to be playing. She told everyone good-bye and stormed out an hour ago.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, then we'll play.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Okay, let's all get in a circle. So how about a game of Truth or Dare?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: That's been way overdone.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not to mention the dares have been really weird...
In Hector's room, during the New Year's party...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You pick dare? I dare you to yell to the party that you're a pretty pink pony!
Hector runs out into the hall and yells down to the rest of the party.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I am a pretty pink pony!
During one camping trip...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So all the people who moonwalked in the last round...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Turn to the person to your left and grab their homemade sandwich...
On the last beach cookout...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So after you go through the peanut butter obstacle course, everyone is going to trade pants...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What if you lost your pants in the spider pit dare?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You're going to have to go back and get those, man...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, was that the same day I ended up with $ZOE's shirt on my head?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No, wait, that was a different time.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Where was I in all this?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Better off.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You guys are so weird.
At that moment, Erik, Dex, and Ben walk up to the group.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, guys! Our dates left us. Can we join you?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Why should we let you join?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I have a great idea for a game! I used to think pin the tail on the donkey was the only game that tickled my insides, but then along came charades!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I always feel like a silent movie star!
Erik tugs at his ear.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sounds like mischief's coming!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'd play charades. That seems... Safe.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Ha ha, awesome.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Great! All we have to do is split up into teams. I'll be the game host.
The group divides themselves.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So Colt, me, $ZOE, Howard, and Ben? Against Nicole, Hannah, Phil, Zach, and Dex?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's the way it looks.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay, now each person will take one turn. I'll say a word or phrase, that person will act it out, and his team will try to guess what he's doing.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Who wants to go first?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'll go!
Nicole goes up and gets her phrase from Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: All right, Nicole, I've started the timer. And go!
Nicole starts wriggling her body and moving up and down like a snake.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What is that? A lava lamp? An octopus?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No, it's an electric eel!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You got it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How did Hannah guess that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Must be a girl thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not so sure about that.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And that's one point for team one. Team two?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, you're up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because I think you'll like it more than me... And I don't want to go first.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't worry, babe. I got you covered. I'll be all over whatever it is you are.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Reassuring.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: All right, Sam! Are you ready?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Lay it on me.
Erik leans into Sam's ear and whispers...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Your phrase is 'Space 'Splosions'!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is that?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You haven't heard? It's only the best television show in the history of television shows!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm... Just going to act out the words.
Erik nods and sits down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh boy... How am I going to act this one out?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know... Maybe out of concern?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For Denni?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! For anyone who's a victim of Blondie Yoohooligan over there.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I do feel a little sorry for Denni. She just got nailed by a cup of coffee.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great, so all of you are siding with her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not it, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. It has nothing to do with being on her side or not.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Does that answer your question?
Colt narrows his eyes.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So you're not just angry about the question.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is about Denni.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sammy, what happened with Denni was...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: An accident?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No. It was an in-the-moment thing, and it was incredibly dumb.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't like that you're so bothered by it, but I can't take it back.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni is just a friend. That's the only thing she is, got it?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Astrid! You spilled coffee on my dress!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni, are you okay? That coffee looks scalding.
Colt looks across the lawn.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? What happened?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess Denni tripped into Astrid and spilled coffee all over her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Seriously, where does that girl keep all those cups of coffee?
Across the lawn...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This is awful!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Do not burst your head. I will fix this. With scissors!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't like that crazed look in your eye...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You must place your trust where it hurts. We go.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I have to see this.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Yoo hoo, Hectorian! I need your sharpest instruments...
Astrid leads Denni and a curious Prissy inside. The nerds reluctantly follow.
Back in the hot tub, $ZOE sighs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Denni and I may not be friends, but I wouldn't wish Astrid on anyone.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're telling me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Think she'll be okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why would you say that?

nodes.text: Say what? I'm not allowed to ask a question?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! It's just...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Mmmrph!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Mmm.... Mmmm...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This isn't another make-out party, is it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mmmm....

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can't complain. This is less traumatic than Dex and Astrid making out.
From behind Colt's head, Sam can see Denni frown then dart away quickly...
Straight into a coffee-wielding Astrid!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ahhh!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ahhh!
Sam leans over to rest her head on Colt's shoulder...
And sinks into the water as Colt moves over!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Blurggh!
Sam comes up for air.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam! You okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Cough... Cough...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You moved!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm sorry?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Forget it.
From behind Colt's head, Sam can see Denni turning away, swept into the crowd of nerds.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, a mouthful of pool water, and she wasn't even paying attention!
As Sam watches, Denni is pushed...
Straight into a coffee-wielding Astrid!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ahhh!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ahhh!
Colt, Sam, Howard, and $ZOE settle into the hot tub, as Ryan and Fryan loiter around, waiting for single girls to get in.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ah... Hot tubs. I remember what relaxed feels like.
Sam settles down to relax...
When she sees Denni, Ben, and the rest of the nerds and their dates walk right past the hot tub across the lawn!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait, Ben, where are we going? I think I'd rather stay inside.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I was promised a grotesque American film... This looks like the frigid outside.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Ugh, don't remind me.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Come on, guys. I wanted to show Prissy the constellations!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: So... `BORED!`
nodes.text_bbcode: So... [color=#3b78e2][i]BORED![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Please, constellations are nothing more than a low-class game of connect the dots.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not according to Captain Quarch!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Keep your voice down, nerd, or I'm going home.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I guess I'll stay out here a little.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Here, let me show you some of the stars. That constellation over there is...
Sam turns back to her friends.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The last time I was in a hot tub, we were on the ski trip.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And that stupid Hawk Gunner was telling stories about how cool he was.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, that avalanche really cooled him down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's a lame pun, Slushie, but I'll let it slide because I hate that guy. He ruined that trip.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, he did.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So Hawk Gunner wasn't the greatest guy, but the trip was perfectly fine. What did you think, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It was fun. We had a great time, didn't we?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We always have a good time.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And we always will.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah...
Sam looks over across the lawn. Denni stares at Colt with a mournful look...

nodes.text: I do. And we seriously need to talk.
Sam pulls Colt into a bedroom.

nodes.text: I take it we're not going to just make out?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No! Not after you decided to join the Denni Defense Patrol!

nodes.text: No, she wasn't! And she was going to be fine.

nodes.text: You might not see it, but there `is` something going on with you and `her!`

nodes.text: All right, fine! So I am attracted to Denni.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you told me you didn't care about her at all. You said you didn't have any feelings for her!

nodes.text: So I stretched the truth a little. But so what?

nodes.text: `So what?!`

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, you heard me! I'm attracted to a lot of girls, Sam.

nodes.text: Yeah. So... You won Prom Queen? That's cool.

nodes.text: Yeah, but it's one dance with Zach. Big deal. There's no point if people aren't jealous of me!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't know anything about being Prom Queen... Except for, you know, that you look pretty and get votes and stuff.

nodes.text: I'm not exactly Prom Queen material.

nodes.speaker: Hector

nodes.text: It's one last call, Amanda.

nodes.text: Hector, this has been one of the worst Proms I've ever had.

nodes.text: I just wanted this to be the best Prom for you.

nodes.text: It's not because you haven't tried. It's because...
